capabilities: Render PGN games and FEN positions as interactive boards in fenced chess code blocks
Navigate moves with keyboard, clickable notation, or drag-to-move
Add and save board circles and arrows as %csl and %cal PGN annotations
Show comments, variations, and move annotation glyphs from PGN NAGs
Configure block options like orientation, startMove, and display toggles
extras: Targets Obsidian desktop only; rendering limits reject oversized blocks or very large PGN trees to keep Obsidian responsive.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display chess games or positions stored as PGN or FEN so they can be replayed and annotated in a note.

relations.evidence: Chess piece artwork is based on the Chessground cburnett assets from chessground.cburnett.css.

summary: Interactive chess viewer that renders PGN games and FEN positions from fenced chess code blocks inside notes.
